description: Lists the tokens that traded in the last day, from LoomDesk's own index of every swap on the chain. Use when picking a token or looking one up by symbol, name or address; for a token's pools use ladder_pools. Not for a wallet's holdings (my_ladders). Returns: tokens[] with address, symbol, name, priceUsd, marketCapUsd, volume24hUsd, change24hPct, tier (established, new, untested), trades24h, fees24hUsd, usdToMovePrice2Pct, ageDays, quietMinutes (since its last swap; a day's volume from a token that stopped trading this morning is stale), keep; with leadersWindowSeconds, mostTraded[] and highestVolume[] over that window instead. Flagged tokens (a stranger cannot sell them, or they tax transfers) are left out. Behavior: read-only, served from the index, a few seconds old at most; costs 1 unit. Errors: none beyond a quota refusal; an unknown query returns an empty list.

leadersWindowSeconds.description: Instead of the list: the most traded and highest volume tokens over this many seconds (300 to 604800).

limit.description: How many tokens to return from the list; default 40.

query.description: A search: symbol, name or 0x address. Left out: the whole list, busiest first.

name: market_tokens
title: Tokens that trade on Robinhood Chain
